prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1023; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its lower center, and the left taillight assembly is broken with the housing pushed inward. Scuffing and paint transfer run along the left quarter panel, which lines up with the reported low-speed contact in the parking lot. Nothing I inspected suggests older damage: the edges are fresh, and no prior repair work is visible. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, the taillight assembly and the left quarter panel trim, followed by refinishing. The labor hours requested fit the scope of this damage, and the invoices submitted show a single set of charges with no duplicated line items.
